course_points.n: Make a U-turn onto Højerup Bygade
Turn slight right onto Ved Munkevænget
Turn sharp left onto Holtug Bygade
Turn slight right onto Holtug Strandvej
At roundabout, take exit 1 onto Søndre Alle

points_of_interest.name: Light house
points_of_interest.description: You can climb to the top for views

points_of_interest.name: During or after rain, turn left and go via Magleby and Strøby
